meta.name: discover
meta.description: Trace a customer workflow and identify the problem, baseline and evidence gaps. Use for discovery or an unclear customer brief, before choosing a solution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊的客户需求理成清楚的问题、基线与证据清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户只丢来一句模糊需求,还没想清到底要解决什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague customer brief into a clear problem, baseline and evidence list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer brief is vague and you must pin down the real problem first.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按方法追踪一条客户工作流，指出问题、现状基线（baseline）和证据缺口，并保留未确认的点。产出是梳理结果，不是方案。
howto.when: 当你需要做客户调研（discovery）、手上的客户简报不够清楚，或在挑选解决方案之前，它会接管这次梳理。

say.text: 帮我追踪这个客户的工作流，找出问题和证据缺口
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法再开始

say.text: 这份客户简报不清楚，先别选方案，做一轮 discovery
标出哪些是未知项，哪些已经验证过
say.note: 会区分实施、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: Claude traces one customer workflow and reports the problem, the current baseline and the evidence gaps, leaving unknowns marked. The output is a tracing result, not a chosen solution.
howto.when_en: Use it for discovery, when a customer brief is unclear, or before picking a solution — it takes over that tracing pass.

say_en.text: Trace this customer workflow and point out the problem and the evidence gaps.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: This brief is unclear, don't pick a solution yet — run a discovery pass.
say_en.note: It won't repeat questions already answered.

say_en.text: Mark what is still unknown and what has been verified.
say_en.note: It separates implementation, verification, deployment, acceptance.
